name: Taiwan
note: Inventions with a recorded country of origin in Wikidata, topped up from the English Wikipedia's per-country invention list articles (CC BY-SA). Every entry passed a Wikidata class check (device, technology, process, product, software, medication ...); diseases, species, discoveries, theorems and food are excluded by ruling. Dates are recorded or parsed from prose and are often approximate.

inventions.name: T112 assault rifle
inventions.description: The T112 assault rifle is a Taiwanese AR-15–style rifle produced by the 205th Armory.

inventions.name: T91 assault rifle
inventions.description: The T91 is a Taiwanese gas-operated, magazine-fed assault rifle chambered for the 5.56×45mm NATO cartridge.

inventions.name: T86 assault rifle
inventions.description: The T86 rifle is a gas-operated, magazine-fed, assault rifle.

inventions.name: T65 assault rifle
inventions.description: The T65 is an assault rifle developed and manufactured by the Combined Logistics Command of the Republic of China (Taiwan) Armed Forces of Taiwan.

inventions.name: T93 sniper rifle
inventions.description: The T93 Sniper Rifle is a 7.62×51mm bolt-action rifle designed and manufactured in Taiwan.

inventions.name: FN MAG
inventions.description: The FN MAG is a Belgian 7.62 mm general-purpose machine gun, designed in the early 1950s at Fabrique Nationale (FN) by Ernest Vervier.

inventions.name: T75 light machine gun
inventions.description: The T75 Light machine gun is produced by the 205th Arsenal, Ministry of Defense, Republic of China (Taiwan).

inventions.name: T75 pistol
inventions.description: The T75 pistol is produced by the 205th Arsenal, Ministry of National Defense in Taiwan.

inventions.name: Kestrel (rocket launcher)
